verdict.rationale: Pilot's own FAQ claims consolidated reporting for US entities with foreign subsidiaries and pricing page mentions 'support for complex business structures,' suggesting some multi-entity capability, but there's no detailed documentation of how consolidation works across multiple domestic entities or independent evidence confirming this in practice. Missing for 10: detailed multi-entity/consolidation workflow documentation, third-party/hands-on confirmation of consolidated financials across entities, and clarity on scope beyond foreign-subsidiary cases.
